data.raw_text:
Global Amazon PPC salaries are shifting - fast.

From our 5,000+ candidate interviews at Pare, one thing’s clear:

The world’s best PPC managers aren’t just in the US or UK anymore.

🇲🇽 Mexico and 🇵🇭 the Philippines are climbing fast

🇮🇳 India still delivers unmatched value

🇵🇱 Eastern Europe commands near-Western rates for analytical depth

It’s not just cost that’s changing.

It’s how brands think about hiring - balancing skill, communication, and culture instead of chasing the lowest price.

We built a full salary breakdown by region, plus the Pare Global PPC Value Index to show where the best balance really sits.
